label: feature
file: src/exportUtils.ts

This is a request for new behaviour, not a bug: export currently only supports CSV and XLSX (see SUPPORTED_FORMATS in src/exportUtils.ts), and toDelimited hardcodes a comma delimiter. Adding a TSV format would mean extending SUPPORTED_FORMATS/CONTENT_TYPES and parameterizing toDelimited's delimiter (and the quoting regex) so a tab-delimited writer can reuse it, similar to how src/export/csv.ts does today.
